_comment: Semi-automatic model/executor selection for the coding lifecycle. Operator-maintained until the live availability prober (Todo 1916) writes this file on a schedule; the prober will emit the same shape. tgw.model_selector.select_executor() consumes only 'executors' and 'roles.<role>.prefer' (today: roles 'implementation' and 'review'). The per-role 'model' hints are carried for humans and the future prober / model-aware executor. Edit /opt/TGW/tgw-lib/config/model-availability.json to change it live; this repo copy is the committed default.
cost_policy: Preserve the operator Claude subscription (flat-rate, the valuable resource) for Claude-model judgement roles. The opencode-zen key is a single gateway to ~every provider: free tier = deepseek-v4-flash, muse-spark-*-contributor-free, gpt-5.3-codex-spark; everything else (Sol, Opus 5, DeepSeek V4 Pro, Grok Build) is pay-per-token on that key. Route bulk / mechanical / draft to the free tier via the opencode executor; use paid-via-zen only for a named 'best' pick when a job needs it.

claude.note: operator Claude subscription (flat-rate) — cheaper than reaching Claude via the zen key; reserve for orchestration, semantic review, high-risk gates, complex implementation

opencode.reason: key + models present (opencode-zen, verified 2026-09-04); still needs the runner branch _execute_opencode() in codex_implement.py + the review worker, an opencode prompt-translator profile, and a refresh of the stale tgw-context MCP block in /home/opencode/.config/opencode/opencode.jsonc (currently pinned to W19-W21 plan 9f303501 / an old source materialization).
opencode.harness: opencode CLI (/home/opencode/.local/bin/opencode); single opencode-zen key = unified gateway to Anthropic, OpenAI, Google, xAI, DeepSeek, GLM, Kimi, muse-spark
opencode.note: muse-spark 1.2/1.3 flagged by operator as a strong new coding model (contributor-free tier) — benchmark standing operator-reported, not independently verified here.

codex.reason: 20x Pro subscription lapsed 2026-08-29 — usage limit until reset (codex models also reachable via opencode-zen as gpt-5.x-codex if needed)

manual.harness: a supervising tgw-coders session services a filesystem task card; always available, last resort

deepseek.reason: no standalone coding backend; DeepSeek models are reached through the opencode executor (opencode-zen)

implementation.research: role 4 (implementation actor): best Sol xhigh / least DeepSeek V4 Pro / other Sonnet 5, DeepSeek V4 Flash for low-risk edits
implementation.note: opencode-first is intentional cost control; falls through to claude while opencode is unavailable. Prefer muse-spark (free coding-tuned) for bulk work; escalate to claude-sonnet-5, or opencode/gpt-5.6-sol paid-via-zen, for complex work once risk-tiering exists.

review.research: role 6 (semantic reviewer): best Opus 5 / least Sonnet 5
review.note: semantic judgement stays on the claude subscription; escalate to claude-opus-5 for lifecycle/authority/rollback changes once the selector takes a risk input. A second-opinion review can run opencode/deepseek-r1 or gpt-5.6-sol via zen.

orchestrator.research: role 1 (plan authority / orchestrator): best Opus 5 / least Sonnet 5

contract_compiler.research: role 2 (contract compiler): best Sol xhigh / least Sonnet 5 — schema-exact structured output; codex-tuned free tier fits

evidence_worker.research: role 3 (evidence / reconnaissance): best DeepSeek V4 Pro / least DeepSeek V4 Flash

mechanical_verifier.research: role 5 (mechanical verifier): best DeepSeek V4 Flash / least GPT Luna — cheap, no semantic judgement

high_risk_gate.research: role 7 (activation / rebinding / rollback gate): never below Opus 5 + a distinct second model

doctor_planner.research: role 8 (doctor / repair planner): best Opus 5 / least Sonnet 5 — escalate to opus-5 for lifecycle or production-boundary repairs

operator_assistant.research: role 9 (operator assistant / receipt navigator): best Sonnet 5 / least DeepSeek V4 Flash

doc_test_drafting.research: role 10 (documentation / test-plan drafting): best Sonnet 5 / least DeepSeek V4 Flash — normative runbooks/contracts stay on claude
